claims: Voting for American Idol 2026 opens during live broadcasts generally starting at 8 p.m. ET/5 p.m. PT on Mondays.
Fans can vote up to 10 times per contestant per voting method for American Idol 2026.
AmericanIdol.com/Vote is a voting method for American Idol 2026.
Text message to 21523 is a voting method for American Idol 2026.
Commenting on official pinned posts on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok is a voting method for American Idol 2026.
Idolvote.abc.com is the website to register and vote for American Idol Season 24 (2026).
Texting the specific contestant’s voting number to 21523 is a way to vote for American Idol.
Official @AmericanIdol accounts on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok have the Official Vote Post for voting by commenting.
Eligibility for American Idol voting requires being 16 or older.
Eligibility for American Idol voting requires being located in the U.S., Puerto Rico, or the Virgin Islands.
The limit for American Idol voting is up to 10 votes per contestant per voting method.
The previous American Idol App is discontinued for 2026.
